title: How to Build an iOS App Without Coding in 2026 (AI-Powered Guide)
summary: Build an iOS app without coding in 2026. Covers two paths: PWA for iPhone (ready in hours, no App Store needed) and native App Store app (React Native via Expo). No Swift required.
body_markdown: Yes, if you go the PWA route. A Blink app works on Android, iPhone, iPad, and desktop — same URL, same codebase, same experience. Android Chrome even prompts users to install PWAs with an on-screen "Add to Home Screen" banner. This is one of the most underrated advantages of the web app approach: you ship once and it works everywhere. Native App Store apps require completely separate builds — iOS (Apple Developer Account, $99/year) and Android (Google Play Console, $25 one-time) are entirely different pipelines. Read[vibe coding for non-technical founders](https://blink.new/blog/vibe-coding-for-non-technical-founders) to see how founders are using this multi-platform approach today.
